Диктор.description: Stable mature male narrator voice, low and even, consistent storytelling timbre

Андрей.description: Male soldier in his early thirties, low hoarse voice, cold and cynical, short clipped phrases, tired from war

Лис.description: Young male soldier about twenty, light slightly nervous voice, informal, fast talker

Милонега.description: Female village healer about forty, warm soft low voice, absolutely calm, slow and gentle

Святополк.description: Middle-aged prince, deep authoritative voice, measured and suspicious, used to command

Ратибор.description: Older nobleman about fifty, arrogant and sly, smooth slightly nasal baritone, mocking tone
